integrity: All exact subset, automorphism and exchange counts can be recomputed with the embedded Python and C++ source files. The two implementations were checked by direct execution. The scientific analysis was reviewed against accessible primary sources and relevant research records.
scientific_limitations: The calculation concerns only the finite graph Q4. Complete finite exhaustive enumeration constitutes the proof; no general-hypercube theorem or external independent certification is claimed. An equivalent unindexed finite census is possible.
title: Total metric bases and optimum exchanges in the binary four-cube
